name: Quarried limestone riprap: the club breakwater, the bridges' and the shores' riprap
meshes: SM_Rock_0..11 (/Game/World/Props, Nanite): Tools/blender/build_props.py rock() over Tools/blender/rock_kit.py; scripts/import_world.py keeps the vertex colours
material: MI_World_Rock (WORLD_LIBRARY: colour 0.52 0.49 0.43, roughness 0.9, pattern 4.25) on M_WorldSurface; scripts/make_materials.py WORLD_SURFACE_CODE, the 'Pattern > 4.15 && Pattern < 4.5' branch

placements.breakwater: AMarinaActor (RayHubbard.marina.json rcyc.breakwater: 6 m wide, 1.6 m crest, ISMs with E1 custom data: CD10 age, CD13 wet, CD15 shade)
placements.riprap: ABridgesActor shore and abutment riprap (HISMs, no custom data: the shader's world noise stands in for the per-stone shade)

real.stone: crushed and blasted limestone armour stone, 0.3 to 1.5 m, angular: flat fracture faces meeting at chipped edges, a few rounded weathered bed faces
real.colour: pale cream-grey on fresh fractures, greyer and darker after decades in the sun; dark crustose lichen in spots a few cm across; black run-off streaks
real.lake: under the pool an olive-brown algae and silt film; a damp darker band with tan clay stain up to the wave-wash line (about 0.6 m on Ray Hubbard's breakwater); a pale dried scum line at its top; a green film in the lowest hand's breadth
real.level: Ray Hubbard swings about a metre below the 435.5 ft pool in a dry autumn (432.3 ft on Oct 11 2026): the ring and algae stand high and dry above the water

measures.size: each stone keeps the old kit's bounding box (rock_kit.OLD_SIZE): placements and packing unchanged
measures.pattern_cells: no repeating squares or lattice at any distance from 1 m

colour_check: waits on Bean's grey-card club photos (breakwater at 1 m and 4 m, the waterline); until then the targets above are from the literature and the blind rounds judge
